name: @wa/app-services
description: The shared application service layer used by BOTH the web and mobile clients: conversations, contacts, groups, channels, communities, stories, calls control, collaboration, notifications, payments and the rest. Platform differences arrive through the @wa/client-core ports (HttpClient, SecureStore, KeyValueStore, DeviceCapabilities, Scheduler) so this package has no DOM and no React-Native imports. Extracted from the web client in M1 so a feature lands on both clients at once instead of web-only.
